groups.title: Agentic navigation
groups.blurb: Moving between what the agent can do right now, and between the agents themselves: a bar that follows context, and a deck of spaces you swipe through.

patterns.title: Contextual taskbar
patterns.desc: A floating bar that resizes to its context: tinted agent suggestions beside your own solid action.

patterns.title: Spaces and agents
patterns.desc: One fixed frame. Swipe sideways for agents, up and down for spaces, each with its own scheme.

groups.title: Conversation core
groups.blurb: The baseline chat surface. Every AI product ships these, so the play here is craft, not coverage.

patterns.title: Prompt input
patterns.desc: The composer: attachments, model pill, and a stop-while-streaming state.

patterns.title: Message thread
patterns.desc: User and assistant turns with hover actions and response branches.

patterns.title: Streaming answer
patterns.desc: Streamed reply with inline sources and follow-ups.

patterns.title: Agent chat
patterns.desc: Chat panel with reasoning chips and a composer.

patterns.title: Code block
patterns.desc: Agent-written code streaming in line by line with syntax tint.

patterns.title: Model & context
patterns.desc: Model picker with capability badges and a live context-window meter.

groups.title: Trust & transparency
groups.blurb: Why the user should believe the output: reasoning made visible, sources attached, confidence stated honestly.

patterns.title: Thinking
patterns.desc: Expandable reasoning trace while the agent works.

patterns.title: Inline citations
patterns.desc: Numbered source chips with an anchored popover pager.

patterns.title: Context sources
patterns.desc: Retrieved knowledge chunks with their sources.

patterns.title: Confidence states
patterns.desc: One claim rendered at three confidence levels. Low is a designed state.

patterns.title: Recommendation
patterns.desc: Agent suggestion with confidence and clear actions.

patterns.title: Feedback capture
patterns.desc: Thumbs with a structured follow-up on negative.

groups.title: Agentic control
groups.blurb: The delegation lifecycle: consent before the agent acts, visibility while it works, accountability after. Intervention points that don't look like errors.

patterns.title: Plan preview
patterns.desc: The agent states its plan in plain language. Proceed, edit, or take over.

patterns.title: Approval card
patterns.desc: Human-in-the-loop question before the agent acts.

patterns.title: Autonomy levels
patterns.desc: Per-task dial for how much the agent may do, observe through autonomous.

patterns.title: Permission scope
patterns.desc: Tools, data, and limits the agent can touch, summarised in plain language.

patterns.title: Task queue
patterns.desc: What the agent will work through. Reorder, remove, watch it clear.

patterns.title: Agent status
patterns.desc: Live status pill with rolling phases, a stop control, and a mid-run redirect.

patterns.title: Tool calls
patterns.desc: Edits, commands, and reads as a compact activity feed.

patterns.title: Task rows
patterns.desc: Live agent task status: running, failed, completed.

patterns.title: Handoff
patterns.desc: The agent escalates to a human with prepared context. Calm, not a failure.

patterns.title: Action receipt
patterns.desc: Evidence of what changed, under whose authority, with a time-limited undo.

patterns.title: Checkpoints
patterns.desc: Named restore points. Confirm inline and roll back with re-verification.

patterns.title: Audit log
patterns.desc: The filterable record of agent actions, with inline receipts.

patterns.title: Error repair
patterns.desc: The structured mistake: acknowledge, show the fix, offer recourse.

groups.title: Output & generative UI
groups.blurb: Where responses stop being text: proposed edits, structured objects, artifacts, and charts.

patterns.title: Artifact
patterns.desc: Generated content in a versioned container with preview and raw views.

patterns.title: Diff view
patterns.desc: Proposed code edits side by side with per-hunk accept and reject.

patterns.title: Diff table
patterns.desc: AI-proposed edits sweeping through tabular data.

patterns.title: Structured data
patterns.desc: Schema output rendered as a readable card, raw JSON one toggle away.

patterns.title: Insight cards
patterns.desc: Paged agent insights with live charts.

patterns.title: Comparison
patterns.desc: Two models stream the same prompt side by side. Pick a winner.

groups.title: Ambient & beyond chat
groups.blurb: The agent outside the thread: boards, nudges, digests, and inline assists that don't make you scroll a transcript to reconstruct state.

patterns.title: Taskboard
patterns.desc: The board is primary, chat is secondary. Work moves when decisions are needed.

patterns.title: Inline assist
patterns.desc: Ghost-text completions. Accept, dismiss, and watch the agent adapt.

patterns.title: Nudge
patterns.desc: A proactive, non-blocking suggestion with a real escape hatch.

patterns.title: Digest
patterns.desc: While-you-were-away summary with rationale and receipts per action.

patterns.title: Notification center
patterns.desc: The classic panel: agent events with severity, read state, and actions.

patterns.title: Command search
patterns.desc: Command palette with live filtering and an empty state.

patterns.title: Agent setup
patterns.desc: Full multi-step setup flow with live preview.
